Now, I'll personally

You're the leader,

If you press the speech bubble

about that? Got it? Alright, try it!

Looks like you managed to move
forward. Alright, as I said before,
this is a Velociprey.

...Didn't I say it before?
Well, whatever.
Anyway, defeating this monster
is the goal, right?

If you press this mark's button,
everyone will start hunting at once.
Alright, try it!

How was it?

By the way...
Has everyone's {強調開始}morale{強調終了} decreased?

press this mark's button
